CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
April 23, 2019 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
6.1
PRESENTATION OF A PROCLAMATION FOR RELAY FOR LIFE - It is recommended the City Council proclaim May 18 and May 19, 2019 as Relay for Life Days in the City of La Mirada and present a proclamation to Randy and Joyce Herbon.
6.1 Proclamation for Relay for Life
6.2
PRESENTATION OF A PROCLAMATION FOR ARBOR DAY - It is recommended the City Council proclaim April 26, 2019 as Arbor Day in the City of La Mirada and present a proclamation to Public Works Director/City Engineer Mark Stowell.
6.2 Proclamation for Arbor Day
7.
APPOINTMENTS
7.1
REAPPOINTMENTS TO THE LA MIRADA COMMUNITY FOUNDATION - It is recommended the City Council reappoint Pete Dames, John Grotz, Russell Hall, David Harbaugh, Michael Lord, Michelle Lynch, Hal Malkin, Martin Nava, Lesley Watkins, and Jim Zoellner to the La Mirada Community Foundation for terms expiring in May 2021; reappoint Judy Quinonez as a non-voting member; and appoint Leticia Revilla as a non-voting member.
7.1 Reappointments to the La Mirada Community Foundation
7.2
CITY COUNCIL APPOINTMENTS TO VARIOUS AGENCIES - It is recommended the Mayor make the necessary appointments of delegates and alternates to the various organizations on which members of the City Council participate.
7.2 City Council Appointments to Various Agencies
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR
8.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the Study Session meeting of April 9, 2019 and the minutes of the regular meeting of April 9, 2019.
8.1 Minutes of April 9, 2019 SS
8.1 Minutes of April 9, 2019 CC
8.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated April 23, 2019 in the total amount of $1,937,277.02.
8.2 Warrant Register - City
8.3
PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT FOR INVESTMENT MANAGEMENT SERVICES - It is recommended the City Council accept the proposal of Chandler Asset Management at a cost not to exceed $52,000 and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement and any extensions on behalf of the City.
8.3 Agreement for Investment Management Services
8.4
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2017-04, STREET NAME SIGN REPLACEMENT PROGRAM - APPROVAL OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS - It is recommended the City Council find that pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act of 1970, the project is categorically exempt under Section 15301 Class 1 (c) and will have no significant effect on the environment; approve plans and specifications for CIP No. 2017-04, Street Name Sign Replacement Program; and authorize the City Clerk to advertise for sealed bids.
8.4 CIP No. 2017-04
9.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
9.1
SECOND READING AND ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO. 709 AMENDING SECTION 10.12.020 OF CHAPTER 10.12 OF TITLE 10 OF THE LA MIRADA MUNICIPAL CODE ESTABLISHING PRIMA FACIE SPEED LIMITS ON CERTAIN CITY STREETS - It is recommended the City Council accept for second reading and adopt Ordinance No. 709 amending Section 10.12.020 of Chapter 10.12 of Title 10 of the La Mirada Municipal Code establishing prima facie speed limits on certain City streets, by title only, and waive further reading.
9.1 Ordinance No. 709 - Second Reading
